messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, including its lighting effects on the person. Change only the environment and its lighting. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands mostly still, then raises her right hand to her mouth in a coughing or gagging motion before lowering it and turning her head slightly.","camera":"The camera is static, positioned at a low angle looking up at the character from a full-body perspective.","clothing":"She wears a dark grey, double-breasted military-style uniform with gold buttons, a brown belt with a gold buckle, and brown leather shoes.","hair_color":"The hair is a vibrant purple color.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled back into a high ponytail with a few loose strands framing the face.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, dark skin, and a neutral facial expression.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor paved area, likely a road or plaza, beneath a large concrete overpass or bridge structure with metal railings and construction equipment visible in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a bright rooftop with antennas and buildings to a road beneath a concrete overpass with railings, red-and-yellow markers, and construction equipment, matching the reference. The character remains in the same low-angle full-body framing and performs the same standing, coughing, and head-turning sequence. Lighting on the character became darker and warmer, consistent with the new environment.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the rooftop scene with the reference underpass/road environment and its lighting, while preserving the character's identity, appearance, expression, action, and camera framing/movement.
unexpected_changes: The character's shoes appear brown in the output rather than black in the source, likely due to the new lighting but still a visible appearance change.
